title: Agreement count plus Hamming distance equals length
statement:
Let $x$ and $y$ be $n$-bit strings. Then the number of coordinates on which $x$ and $y$ agree, together with their Hamming distance $d(x, y)$ — the number of coordinates on which they differ — sums to the length:
\[
  \#\{i : x_i = y_i\} + d(x, y) = n.
\]
hypotheses_covered: two n-bit strings x and y (over Fin n)
replaced:
For any two $n$-bit strings $x$ and $y$,
\[
  \mathrm{agreementCount}(x, y) + \mathrm{hammingDist}(x, y) = n.
\]
The agreeing and disagreeing coordinates partition $\{0, \ldots, n-1\}$.
